title: The Restless Dead
description: Father Osric has tended these graves for decades, but lately the dead won't stay buried. Something old in the deepest vault beneath the churchyard is waking them. Go down, see what's stirring, and put as many of the risen back to rest as you can.

objectives.desc: Investigate the crypt door in the churchyard
Slay the crypt ghouls prowling the galleries
